engineMappingsNotOfficialFaq.approvalState: Root final implementation contract, accepted within the actual recorded behavior scope; engine mappings are not official FAQ.
engineMappingsNotOfficialFaq.tokenEligibility: No holder may gain another of this skill family's three tokens while already holding any one, across original sources. Grant only after actual face-up original Hand material delivery.
engineMappingsNotOfficialFaq.tokenLifetime: Tokens own frozen original source and remain holder-executable when original giver loses the skill; no live qualification recheck of original giver after issuance.
engineMappingsNotOfficialFaq.lei: Optional holder-native Dying activation consumes token once, recovers to HP1 then draws1 through real native children; no old maxHP penalty.
engineMappingsNotOfficialFaq.fu: Optional holder Play-start activation consumes once and discards0..2 legal cards from one living target HEJ, with blind slots for Hand; no old extra draw.
engineMappingsNotOfficialFaq.song: Optional holder unique actual Slash declaration consumes once to add0..2 distinct legal targets preserving native use and card restrictions; no old damage-total penalty.
engineMappingsNotOfficialFaq.lisi: Only actual out-of-turn uses qualify, including native own-Slash Dodge and actual counterspell/rescue uses. Pure Duel/Barbarian Slash and Arrow Dodge provision does not qualify. Recover all still-valid original physical materials actually arriving in public DiscardPile to one other living target whose current Hand count is <= owner. No replacement or fake entity for zero-material uses.
engineMappingsNotOfficialFaq.materialCategory: Category follows native card-category classification; exact appearance/payment timing remains implementation mapping, not verified FAQ.
